claim_verdicts.evidence: Arithmetic properties verified: result = M + ((P − M) − (M − O)) / 6, so with O/M/P 4/6/14 → 6 + (8 − 2)/6 = 7 and 2/4/12 → 4 + (8 − 2)/6 = 5, i.e. pulled toward P when P − M > M − O. The 'one common way' part has no governing doc: versions.yaml has no key for estimation practice (only scrum 2020, which does not cover it) and refs/ has no management mirror. Hedged wording is a DECISIONS.md owner choice; kind fact, not number/syntax, so non-blocking.
